name: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank

status.en: 95 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 32% fewer than the week before, most of them in Gaza, Jerusalem and Hebron.
status.nb: 95 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 32 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Gaza, Jerusalem og Hebron.

summary.en: Israeli forces ended a ten-day operation in Hebron, withdrawing after detaining residents and threatening a broader West Bank offensive. The IDF killed six Hamas operatives, including two who participated in the Oct 7 attack, and a separate strike in Gaza City killed one person and wounded five. Iran warned it could reopen the Strait of Hormuz within two days if its conditions are met. The UCDP recorded 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024. These actions follow earlier reports of settler arrests during an illegal outpost evacuation and ongoing displacement concerns in Gaza.
summary.nb: Israelske styrker avsluttet en ti-dagers operasjon i Hebron, og trakk seg tilbake etter å ha arrestert innbyggere og truet med en bredere offensiv på Vestbredden. IDF drepte seks Hamas-operatører, inkludert to som deltok i angrepet 7. oktober, og et separat angrep i Gaza-by drepte én person og såret fem. Iran advarte om at de kan gjenåpne Hormuzstredet innen to dager dersom deres betingelser oppfylles. UCDP registrerte 21 440 dødsfall i kamp i 2024. Disse handlingene følger tidligere rapporter om arrestasjoner av bosettere under en ulovlig utpost-evakuering og pågående bekymringer om fordrivelse i Gaza.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters have denied that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
